Hi Claire / Ethan —

Hope you both are well. We're approaching GlimmerAI's renewal window and want to run a joint QBR + roadmap demo to cover: usage trends, cost/latency optimization opportunities, and the proposed product roadmap that maps to your inference workloads.

Proposed 90-minute windows (PST):
- Tue Feb 16: 9:00–10:30am
- Wed Feb 17: 11:00am–12:30pm
- Thu Feb 18: 2:00–3:30pm

Please pick the option that works best and share any additional stakeholders (eg: engineering lead, security). I've attached a draft agenda and a short pre-demo checklist so we can tailor the demo.

Attachments: QBR_agenda_v1.pdf (pdf)

If none of these work, let me know a week window and we'll find an alternate.

Thanks — looking forward.

Regards,

Thanks for the note and the agenda. Quick note on availability: Feb 16/17 are tight for our execs because of a product launch, but Ethan (our ML infra lead) can definitely attend and would like deep-dive on model routing and KV cache behavior. Would you be able to run a shorter focused demo for Ethan on Feb 17 at 11:00am PST (30–45 mins) that covers runtime behavior and quantization recommendations?

If we'd like execs present for the full QBR with roadmap we'll need to move that to the following week. Also, can you include our security contact (we'll add them once I confirm internally)?

Sergio — can you own the demo and surface the kernel/latency slides? Rafael, please join for an ops/deployment Q&A (including Dedicated vs Private sizing recommendations).

Claire/Ethan — if you can confirm Ethan's calendar invite I'll send a short pre-demo checklist + a quick runbook for a 15-minute dry-run the day before.
